project_title: SomnaScan AI - Clinical Sleep Disorder Diagnostic Dashboard
context: Clinical Medical AI Diagnostic Tool for Sleep Disorder Screening

typography.heading_font: Work Sans, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif
typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, Source Sans 3, sans-serif

layout_and_grid.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6
layout_and_grid.card_style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm p-5 space-y-4

key_components.name: Header & Quick Controls
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with clinical branding, active model version indicator, 'Load Demo Profiles' dropdown menu, and 'Reset Inputs' action.
features: Preset profiles: Healthy Adult, High-Stress Worker (Insomnia), Apnea Risk Senior
Clinical timestamp and patient ID simulator

key_components.name: Patient Input Panel
key_components.description: Comprehensive diagnostic form organized into categorized tabs/sections: Demographics, Sleep Metrics, Vitals & Activity.

key_components.name: Prominent Primary Diagnosis Banner
key_components.description: High-visibility clinical banner updating instantly upon input changes.

states.None: Green banner (bg-emerald-500 text-white) with checkmark icon and 'No Disorder Detected' text
states.Insomnia: Yellow/Amber banner (bg-amber-500 text-slate-900) with alert icon and 'Insomnia Detected' text
states.Sleep Apnea: Red banner (bg-rose-600 text-white) with urgent icon and 'Sleep Apnea Risk Detected' text

key_components.name: Confidence Breakdown & Decision Tree Tally
key_components.description: Visual percentage breakdown calculated by parsing all 10 decision trees from model_logic.json and computing class proportions.
key_components.visuals: Animated progress bars with exact tree vote counts (e.g., '7 / 10 Decision Trees -> 70% Confidence')

key_components.name: Patient vs Baseline Comparison Cards
key_components.description: Interactive visual cards highlighting key deviations from population baseline averages.

key_components.name: Model & Project Details Card
key_components.description: Card displaying strict specs required by prompt: 'Model: Random Forest, Split: 80% Train / 20% Test, Accuracy: 88.00%' along with tree evaluation metadata.

key_components.name: Medical Liability Disclaimer Footer
key_components.description: Standard clinical disclaimer required at the bottom with clear warning styling.
key_components.text: DISCLAIMER: This software tool is an exploratory machine learning screening demonstrator and is NOT intended for primary clinical diagnosis or medical treatment decisions. Consult a qualified sleep specialist or healthcare professional for formal diagnosis.

model_execution_rules.evaluation_method: Traverse each tree object recursively. Evaluate condition: if patient_input[node.feature] <= node.threshold, go to left child, else right child. When node has 'diagnosis', record leaf class. Tally votes across all trees to calculate percentage confidence.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements, inputs, selects, buttons, and summary cards must contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all React code in Javascript (.js / .jsx) as instructed.
Parse model_logic.json tree structures directly in memory to run the Random Forest model on patient input state changes.
Do NOT use teal green (#1B93A4) or Space Grotesk font as prohibited by design guidelines.
Ensure high contrast in light mode: deep slate text over crisp white cards with soft slate borders.
Include toast notifications using Sonner when an example patient profile is loaded.
Strictly include all data-testid attributes listed in testing_attributes.
